folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B272
folds.body:
All26summary rows and the complete C5 inventory method/commands were read, alongside the full [C5 assignment](C5_reconcile.md). The inventory deliberately distinguishes mtime discovery, Git-path history and owner-recorded evidence. It is an October25snapshot, not a present source/process/worktree census. Mtime is not an authoring date; a path/commit list does not establish live implementation, integration, app adoption or current playback. Reading these26summary rows does not credit the linked checkpoint bodies as read by this pass. They retain their independent inventory dispositions.

Keep the specific supersession logic: later R3/O4integration resolves the older combined-integration reservation, engine-bindings backlog transfers to W1–W4rather than a second active owner, home/household/potion receipts qualify older uncommitted/pending wording, and Q1/Q2component limits do not replace the later lives/regions record. Those are dated lineage claims, not freshly inspected commits, retired worktrees or currently adopted bundles. Native export-function/import-function proof stays distinct from literal file controls; app snapshot staging differs from adoption. Unplayed combat, old-age, alternate cargo, alternate chain-good, moved-box and source-law cases remain their own scoped gaps, not an inferred failure of every lane.

The assignment's named live writers, four-reader authorization, about890dirty paths, branch integration plan and retirement candidates belong to that dispatch. They neither prove current workers are live nor authorize new agents, messaging, merge, commit, pruning or deletion in this docs-only goal. Its request for a dated PROJECT append is superseded by the current PROJECT shape rule: replace affected current-state lines and retain history in the log. No PROJECT change is needed for this review, and no row becomes a new standing priority. Existing AD41/shared-owner practice and AD36/AD42/AD43 apply; optional human review is not a repeated mandatory acceptance gate. The actual old source/test/run evidence was not rerun here.

The full [Q18 return](../carry-out-queue-2026-10-26/runs/q18-ideas-triage.last.md) and [primary tooling receipt](../carry-out-queue-2026-10-26/primary-adoption/RECEIPT.md) were also read in B272. Q18's12source spot-checks and top20packets do not establish all packet consumers or whole-project content coverage. Its global one-file condition was unmet because the shared tree already had unrelated changes; that does not mean the owned one-file delivery failed or justify cleaning another writer's paths. Primary tooling/page browser proof, a3226suite on its earlier inputs and later focused isolated-build check remain tooling evidence, not new gameplay or installed delivery.
